description.p: Mnemo is a local-first desktop study app for flashcards, spaced repetition and deliberate practice. Everything is stored on your own computer and no account is required.

ul.li: Folders, tags, favourites, search and archiving for study sets
Flashcards, adaptive learning, writing practice, SM-2 spaced repetition, practice tests and a matching game
Import from CSV, TSV, JSON and Quizlet-style text; export to CSV, TSV, JSON, Markdown and PDF
Insights with due counts, daily goals, streaks and activity heatmaps
Optional AI assistance through OpenAI-compatible APIs, Gemini or a local Ollama
English and German interface with bundled offline fonts

description.p: There is no telemetry and no vendor-hosted service. AI features only call the provider you configure yourself.

screenshot.caption: The study library with sample activity, daily goal and recent sets
A study set with search, favourites and folder filters
The AI study assistant in dark mode with per-set context controls
Appearance settings with display font, language, theme and accent colour

description.p: First release with Flatpak distribution. The Flatpak replaces the Debian package; the AppImage and the Windows installer are unchanged.
Updates for the Flatpak are delivered by Flatpak itself, so the in-app updater is inactive in this build.
